title: VEGO-AI Iris requirements closure and proposal execution program
claimBoundary: This board controls work and evidence. It does not create human review, supervisor acceptance, expert labels, medical authorization, recipient access, rehearsal, approval, or submission evidence.

medicalFallback.rule: If any G1-G6 medical gate lacks its required evidence at the checkpoint, Plan B becomes the committed execution path and Plan A remains a conditional annex.
